description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Zenith Mode], [Conditional Attach Element 3 with Stacking From Party], [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode: Mog (Dragoon)], [Nature's Warrior Mode] to user. Causes [ATK -15%, DEF -70% (25s)] and [Imperil Prismatic 20% (25s)] to all enemies

description.name: Zenith Mode: Mog (Dragoon)
description.text: Increases all elemental infusion damage bonuses by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY abilities, Dragoon abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts [Spirit Attack: Mog II] on another ally after that ally uses a Dragoon ability (max 2), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Moogle Jump+
description.text: Four single ranged jump attacks (1.10 each), 40% DEF piercing

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action

description.name: Conditional Attach Element 3 with Stacking From Party
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire 3 with Stacking]/[Attach Ice 3 with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning 3 with Stacking]/[Attach Earth 3 with Stacking]/[Attach Wind 3 with Stacking]/[Attach Water 3 with Stacking]/[Attach Holy 3 with Stacking]/[Attach Dark 3 with Stacking]/[Attach Poison 3 with Stacking] if current number of combined Attach Element statuses on party members are a majority Attach Fire/Ice/Lightning/Earth/Wind/Water/Holy/Dark/Poison. In the case of ties the prior listed order is used to determine status granted

description.name: Nature's Warrior Mode
description.text: ATK +150%, DEF and RES +25%, cast speed x999999 to Dragoon abilities, triggers [Nature's Warrior] after using Dragoon abilities

description.name: Imperil Prismatic 20% (25s)
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 20% (25s)], [Imperil Ice 20% (25s)], [Imperil Lightning 20% (25s)], [Imperil Earth 20% (25s)], [Imperil Wind 20% (25s)], [Imperil Water 20% (25s)], [Imperil Holy 20% (25s)], [Imperil Dark 20% (25s)] and [Imperil Poison 20% (25s)]
